# PropertyInitializationFlaws

<Badge type="info" text="info" /> <Badge type="tip" text="on by default" /> <Badge type="tip" text="quick-fix" />

Group: [Unused](/rules/#unused) · PhpStorm name: `PropertyInitializationFlawsInspection`

Property defaults and constructor assignments that do nothing: an explicit
`= null` default (untyped properties are already `null`), a default that
merely repeats the inherited one, a default on a private property that the
constructor unconditionally overwrites, and a constructor assignment that
writes exactly the default value.

## Example

::: code-group

```php{12,17,20,23,34,35} [Before]
<?php
namespace Shop;

class Tag {}

class BaseCart
{
    protected $items = [];
    private $secret = 'x';
    public static $currency = 'EUR';
    protected $tagClass = Tag::class;
    protected $notes = NULL;
}

class Cart extends BaseCart
{
    protected $items = [];
    private $secret = 'x';
    public static $currency = 'EUR';
    protected $tagClass = Tag::class;
    protected $notes = 'n/a';

    private $total = 0;
    private $lines = [];
    private $count = 0;
    private $owner;
    private $history = [];
    private $later = 'a';
    protected $shown = 1;

    public function __construct($owner)
    {
        $this->total = 100;
        $this->lines = [];
        $this->owner = null;
        $this->count = $this->count + 1;
        $this->history = array_merge($this->history, [$owner]);
        if ($owner) {
            $this->later = 'b';
        }
        $this->shown = 2;
    }

    public function reset()
    {
        $this->lines = [];
    }
}
```

```php [After fix]
<?php
namespace Shop;

class Tag {}

class BaseCart
{
    protected $items = [];
    private $secret = 'x';
    public static $currency = 'EUR';
    protected $tagClass = Tag::class;
    protected $notes;
}

class Cart extends BaseCart
{
    protected $items = [];
    private $secret = 'x';
    public static $currency = 'EUR';
    protected $tagClass = Tag::class;
    protected $notes = 'n/a';

    private $total;
    private $lines = [];
    private $count = 0;
    private $owner;
    private $history = [];
    private $later = 'a';
    protected $shown = 1;

    public function __construct($owner)
    {
        $this->total = 100;
        $this->lines = [];
        $this->owner = null;
        $this->count = $this->count + 1;
        $this->history = array_merge($this->history, [$owner]);
        if ($owner) {
            $this->later = 'b';
        }
        $this->shown = 2;
    }

    public function reset()
    {
        $this->lines = [];
    }
}
```

:::

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 12: Explicit null default is redundant; remove it.</li>
<li>line 17: Default repeats the inherited value; drop the re-declaration.</li>
<li>line 20: Default repeats the inherited value; drop the re-declaration.</li>
<li>line 23: Default is always replaced by the constructor; remove it.</li>
<li>line 34: Assignment writes the property&#39;s default value; remove it.</li>
<li>line 35: Assignment writes the property&#39;s default value; remove it.</li>
</ul>

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Effect |
|---|---|---|---|
| `REPORT_DEFAULTS_FLAWS` | bool | `true` | Enables Check 1 (N, S) and pattern O of Check 2. |
| `REPORT_INIT_FLAWS` | bool | `true` | Enables Check 2 (W, and O when the other option is on). |

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "PropertyInitializationFlaws": {
      "enabled": false,
      "options": {
        "REPORT_DEFAULTS_FLAWS": true,
        "REPORT_INIT_FLAWS": true
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore PropertyInitializationFlaws

/**
 * @noinspection PropertyInitializationFlawsInspection
 */
```
